claims.text: Failure modes: a malformed firm thresholds file (indicators.yaml) is refused naming the file and its line; no figures, queue or indicators are shown (ThresholdsError and FirmConfigError are routed through summary.refusal).

Idempotency/determinism: the queue and indicators are a pure function of the case files, recomputed per request; no state is written by the panel. Queue order is fixed (size either way, then account, then each account's own order), proven by the ordering contract tests.

Partial failure / overrides: indicators and the queue read the statement with overrides applied, so an override takes a line out of the queue and out of its cash indicator (new contract test added by this seat).
Task test: a cash deposit at the single-deposit limit (£2,500.00) appears in the queue with its single_cash_deposit indicator; £2,499.99 does not; P19 invariant across several deposits.
Shipped thresholds are labelled illustrative; a firm threshold is not, and decides what fires.

Data/migrations: not applicable — no stored data, schema, case-log or evidence format changes; summary JSON gains additive keys queue and thresholds and each account gains indicators. PII: descriptions shown only escaped (P8 test).
Security: no new entry point; the panel and queue ride the existing token-, Host- and Origin-checked '/' and '/api/case' routes (server.py:130,145). No new dependency, no secrets.
Performance: raising indicators, the queue and the merged queue for a 10,000-line categorised statement takes about 0.5 s, within R52's 2 s recompute target.
claims.proof_cmd: python scratchpad/perf.py (10,000 random lines, shipped thresholds)

claims.text: Regression: full suite and lint pass.

claims.text: Marker tiers: the T43 tests run under contracts/invariants.
Observability: gap — no log line or count records indicators raised / queue size per render; design places these in cma report (R50, Tier 2), not built.

Operability: rollback is reverting the commit or CMA_RULESET=v1 (no cash_deposit category); no flag needed for a read-only panel; no config/secret changes beyond the optional existing indicators.yaml path.
Docs: gap — README/design not updated for the panel; summary.py module docstring documents the new sections.

notes: Gaps for the owner: (1) Payload size — the queue and every indicator's lines render unpaged; a 10,000-line random statement gives 5,194 queue rows on one page, while the design's failure-modes table says lines are paged at 10,000+ (R52). Paging needs a UI design decision, left out of scope. (2) No observability signal (queue size, indicator counts) per case; belongs to cma report (R50). (3) README not updated.
